thread_title: Photobucket pics working all of the sudden?!
breadcrumb: Photobucket pics working all of the sudden?!

posts.body_html:
As many of you know, photobucket pulled the plug to hotlinking (ie. uploading pics from their site and then posting them here on the Sarracenia Forum) last year: www.theverge.com/2017/7/4/15919224/photobucket-broken-images-amazon-ebay-etsy-paid-update

I was sending out emails this morning and noticed that the hundreds of photobucket pictures that were broken on this forum seem to be repaired. Am I seeing things or did photobucket restore all the photos that they pulled?

posts.body_html: Photobucket got a new CEO who scrapped the previous one's pricing scheme and made all previously uploaded pictures viewable through hotlinking again.  I think they're now charging $2.50 per month to be able to hotlink pictures?  I'm not entirely clear - I was reading a news article about it but couldn't find the same information on their website.

posts.body_html: Just got an email from Photobucket. Free hosters will be restricted to 25MB of hosting bandwidth per month. Free hosters who use more than 25MB of bandwidth will have all of their hosted photos watermarked and blurred.
